description: Audio devices use electronic components to play or capture sound.
Computing and connectivity hardware includes tablets, displays, and USB accessories. Classify a physical tablet as hardware even when it displays recipes.
Wearable garments belong to Clothing even when decorated with book or technology illustrations.
Physical cookware and food preparation utensils belong to Home & Kitchen. A cookbook is a book rather than cookware.
Household textiles used on furniture or in rooms belong to Home & Kitchen; wearable fabric garments belong to Clothing.
Printed reading and educational works belong to Books, including novels, poetry, textbooks, and cookbooks. Depictions of books printed on garments do not make the garment a book.
